title: Sensor Diagnosis for Fuel and Emissions Monitoring in Heavy-Duty Diesel Vehicles
abstract: arXiv:2610.21188v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Faulty sensor readings can distort estimates of fuel use and carbon dioxide emissions from diesel engines. We evaluate two procedures that use relationships learned from healthy measurements to diagnose faults and guide fuel correction. The diagnosis procedure tests whether replacing a suspected faulty reading with an estimated healthy value helps a model predict another sensor's recorded reading more accurately. It then predicts the fault type and decides whether to report the diagnosis. We evaluate five synthetic fault types on 217 steady-state operating points from a heavy-duty diesel engine, excluding all measurements at selected engine speeds from training. Across 31,500 fault-injected groups of 20 operating points, it issues diagnoses for 77.3% of groups, with 92.1% of diagnoses issued on these groups correct. translated_title: 重型柴油车燃油与排放监测的传感器诊断
translated_abstract: 有故障的传感器读数可能会扭曲对柴油发动机燃油消耗和二氧化碳排放的估计。我们评估了两种利用从健康测量数据中学到的关系来诊断故障并指导燃油修正的程序。诊断程序测试用估计的健康值替换疑似故障读数是否有助于模型更准确地预测另一个传感器的记录读数，然后预测故障类型并决定是否报告诊断结果。我们在来自重型柴油发动机的217个稳态运行点上评估了五种合成故障类型，并在训练时排除了选定发动机转速下的所有测量数据。在31,500组各含20个运行点的故障注入数据组中，该程序对77.3%的组发出了诊断，其中发出的诊断有92.1%是正确的。燃油修正程序在各个运行点上使用不同的传感器选择规则，测试每个替换……
tldr: 本文提出基于健康测量数据学习关系的传感器故障诊断与燃油修正程序，在重型柴油发动机217个稳态运行点上对五种合成故障类型评估，实现了77.3%的诊断覆盖率且诊断准确率达92.1%，有助于修正因传感器故障导致的燃油消耗和碳排放估计偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes sensor fault diagnosis and fuel correction procedures leveraging relationships learned from healthy measurements, which were evaluated on five synthetic fault types across 217 steady-state operating points of a heavy-duty diesel engine, achieving 77.3% diagnostic coverage with 92.1% accuracy to correct biased estimates of fuel use and CO2 emissions.
